messages:
Raj (Auditor): Hi team — preparing ISO/SOC crosswalk. Need an evidence package that includes: RBAC pre/post snapshots for sampled high-privilege changes, cloud IAM policy version history, KMS rotation proof with key policy hash + event IDs, vuln triage -> incident linkage, service-account deprovision proof including pipeline log, and a control crosswalk file mapping files to control IDs. Also want verification artifacts: signed manifest, sha256 list, and simple verification README. Req doc: https://files.redwood.example.com/audits/crosswalk-2026

Maya (sec-eng): Hi @Raj — we can produce an evidence package. Quick Q: sampling — do you want a focused sample on high-privilege roles and SAs (recommended) or random? Also retention preference?

Raj (Auditor): Focused on high-privilege roles and any SAs that were changed. Retention: 1 year minimum; 3 years if feasible. Important: timestamps must be UTC/RFC3339 and KMS rows should include policy_sha256 and CloudTrail event IDs for GenerateDataKey/Decrypt so we can replay if needed.

Derek (eng-security): Plan outline: we'll produce a package with the following layout:
- RBAC_SNAPSHOTS/sample-<id>-pre.csv and sample-<id>-post.csv (role -> principal -> binding_type)
- IAM/policy-history/<role>-versions.csv (version,author,ts,commit_sha)
- KMS/rotations.csv (key_id,rotation_ts,rotation_version,policy_sha256,cloudtrail_event_id)
- VULN/triage_map.csv (vuln_id,cvss,discover_ts,triage_owner,fix_pr,deploy_ts,incident_id)
- SA/deprov_proofs.csv (sa,actor,ts,pr_link,pipeline_run_url)
- control_crosswalk.csv (file_name,control_id,control_desc)
- README.md (verification steps)
- manifest.sha256 and manifest.sig (GPG signed)

Maya (sec-eng): We'll attach PR/commit SHAs and CI run URLs for any RBAC/IAM change. For pre/post snapshots we capture state within 5 minutes before the change event and within 5 minutes after completion whenever possible. We'll also include the event id for the k8s audit log entry that triggered capture.

Luis (infra): I'll schedule the export job and add an oncall trace. @audit-bot start_export --bundle=crosswalk-2026-04 --include=rbac,iam,kms,vuln,sa --sign

audit-bot: export queued: job_id=job-2026-04-22-501, started=2026-04-22T11:02:07Z. Target: s3://redwood-audit-exports/crosswalk-2026/job-501. Progress will be posted to this thread. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Raj (Auditor): Two clarifications: 1) for KMS, include both the key policy hash and the key description (alias) in the CSV; 2) for SA deprovs include the pipeline log snippet showing success (redact secrets). Also include a control mapping to SOC2/ISO identifiers.

Derek (eng-security): Affirmative. KMS CSV header will be: key_id,alias,rotation_ts,rotation_version,policy_sha256,cloudtrail_event_id,event_ts. All timestamps RFC3339 UTC. SA deprov rows will include a short redacted pipeline snippet and link to the full run that auditors can request.

Maya (sec-eng): We'll sign the manifest with our audit GPG key and publish a sha256 file. README will include commands to verify signature and sha256 sums, and notes on how to replay CloudTrail events with the provided event IDs.

audit-bot: job-2026-04-22-501 update: gather stage complete. Bundling artifacts into crosswalk-2026-04-22-job-501.tar.gz. Generating manifest and signing. Upload target: s3://redwood-audit-exports/crosswalk-2026/job-501/crosswalk-2026-04-22-job-501.tar.gz

Luis (infra): Presigned link (7 days): https://s3-presigned.redwood.example.com/crosswalk-2026/job-501/crosswalk-2026-04-22-job-501.tar.gz?X-Amz-Expires=604800. PM'ing credentials separately. Will post manifest file names when upload completes.

audit-bot: job-2026-04-22-501 complete: uploaded crosswalk-2026-04-22-job-501.tar.gz; manifest: crosswalk-2026-04-22.manifest.sha256; signature: crosswalk-2026-04-22.manifest.sig

Raj (Auditor): Downloaded and verified GPG signature and sha256. Initial pass looks good. I'll run a deeper review and follow up within 48 hours if I have questions. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

Maya (sec-eng): Thanks — standing by for follow-ups. If you need extended retention (3y) let us know and we can re-run an export with longer retention metadata.

Derek (eng-security): Adding to README: how to validate KMS policy_sha256 vs exported policy (sha256sum policy.json) and how to match cloudtrail_event_id to our CloudTrail console to replay the GenerateDataKey entries.

Raj (Auditor): Perfect. I'll revert after deeper review. Appreciate the quick turnaround.
